create_olmo2_config: create an Olmo2Config instance with default or custom model hyperparameters
initialize_olmo2_model: initialize an Olmo2Model using an Olmo2Config instance for model construction
access_model_config: access the configuration from an Olmo2Model instance via the config attribute
configure_key_value_heads: configure num_key_value_heads for GQA attention in Olmo2Config automatically defaults to num_attention_heads
setup_tensor_parallel_plan: setup base_model_tp_plan for tensor parallelism across q_proj k_proj v_proj o_proj gate_proj up_proj down_proj
